data.title: 和泉纱雾 · 被炉绘图舱
data.description: 她的房间中央，被炉上架着绘图板与显示器，她整个人缩在被炉里只露出脑袋和拿笔的手，耳机夹着碎发；屏幕上是从未示人的新插画，房间灯光全关只剩屏幕光。
data.action: 缩在被炉中，戴着耳机用数位笔绘制新插画。
data.promptProse: Sagiri Izumi sits tucked deeply into the kotatsu, only her head and stylus hand emerging beneath the blanket. A drawing tablet and monitor stand on the tabletop, her headset catching loose silver hair. The horizontal medium view includes her pink hoodie at the neck and the darkened room beyond the work area. Screen light illuminates her focused eyes, pen tip and blanket rim, leaving the surrounding furniture mostly in darkness.
